subject: SIG/CAIQ derivative mapping & long-tail evidence sourcing
messages:
From: Lara Patel <lara.patel@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG baseline + CAIQ gaps (initial intake)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is Acme's SIG baseline dump (PDF) and a short list of follow-up questions from our compliance team. We run CAIQ checks in our portal and need Redwood to provide: 1) a mapping from your SIG answers to CAIQ controls, and 2) any evidentiary artifacts for long-tail questions (logs, config screenshots, SOC2 excerpts).

Our timeline is tight — can you share an ETA for a mapping spreadsheet and a list of owners for the long-tail evidence by next Tuesday? We're trying to complete vendor review for the payments team.

Best,
Lara
--
Lara Patel
Vendor Risk Manager, Acme Financial
Lara.Patel@acme.com

Attachment: acme-sig-export-20261111.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lara Patel <lara.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG baseline + CAIQ gaps (initial intake)

Thanks Lara — filing this into our intake flow. Quick plan:
- I will produce a SIG->CAIQ mapping sheet (tabbed) that flags where answers are directly equivalent, where we need a derived mapping, and where evidence is required.
- Marissa will own gathering SOC2 excerpts and any policy docs.
- Ben will triage infra artifacts (logs, GCP/AWS console screenshots).
- Karthik will run the Whistic/OneTrust profile sync to verify existing attachments and avoid duplication.

ETA: initial mapping + evidence inventory by EOD Monday (2026-11-16). If that works, we'll send the spreadsheet and a short action matrix with owners and deadlines.

Couple of questions for you now:
1) Do you prefer CAIQ field-level linking (control IDs) or a narrative summary?
2) Any constraints on sharing SOC2 excerpts (redaction/CTA)?

Thanks,
Irene
--
Irene Choi
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG baseline + CAIQ gaps (initial intake)

Hi Lara — attaching the first pass mapping and evidence inventory (see attachments). Notes:
- SIG questions that map cleanly to CAIQ are in the first tab.
- We created a "derivative mapping" column where we combine multiple SIG responses into a single CAIQ control statement (marked with rationale).
- Long-tail evidence rows flagged with "ownership" column: policy (Marissa), SOCExcerpts (Irene), infra proofs (Ben).
- We included a minimal redaction approach on SOC excerpts (page/section references + redacted copy) — please confirm if that meets Acme's procurement requirements.

Action items:
1) Lara to confirm CAIQ linking preference (field-level vs narrative) — due Wed 2026-11-17.
2) Ben to upload infra screenshots to Whistic profile and share link — due Wed 2026-11-17.
3) Marissa/Irene to prepare SOC excerpt package for secure upload to your SFTP/portal once you confirm redaction guidance.

Quick attachments: SIG-to-CAIQ-mapping-v1.xlsx, long-tail-evidence-inventory.csv

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m call if you want to walk the mapping.

Best,
Marissa
--

marissa@redwood.com
